2638-3000-3510-4875.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
2638-3000-3510-4875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

539-3821-4679-5147-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-5147-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

424-868-8217.description:
Cast Gaze of Adamaro by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Gaze of Adamaro.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Gaze of Adamaro, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting an opponent.
Resolve Gaze of Adamaro, dealing damage to an opponent and adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
424-868-8217.notes: If an opponent has no cards in hand, Gaze of Adamaro cannot deal damage to them.

3764-4659-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.
3764-4659-7924.notes: Once you have mana, you can instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities to draw cards.

618-6132-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-457-1458-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
392-457-1458-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

3764-6798-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-7317.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7317.description:
Cast Here Comes a New Hero! by paying {8}{U}, causing a player to draw six cards and creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7317.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
5147-6972-7230.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1308-1409-5422.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve the The Third Doctor trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1456-3713-4289-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-5663-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1170-2604-5078-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-2604-5078-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-3372-6006-6965.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-6006-6965.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

454-1336-1978.description:
Cause Heronblade Elite to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2171-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-5686.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3365-5742-5743-6753.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Aeromoeba ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5670-6719-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6719-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

3372-4050-4785-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-4785-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-5876.description:
Activate Elenda's Hierophant by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Elenda's Hierophant triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3525-5115-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
3525-5115-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-5431-6488.notablePrerequisites:
The Flame of Keld is level 3.
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-5431-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to The Flame of Keld.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to The Flame of Keld.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to The Flame of Keld.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-5431-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

1494-4875-5974.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Numa triggers, causing you to pay {10} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4179-5280-5919.manaNeeded: {6}{G}{G}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {8}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
4179-5280-5919.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-2525-2947.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1636-4050-4424-5347.notablePrerequisites: Dog Walker on the battlefield face up.
1636-4050-4424-5347.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dog Walker, adding {R/W}.
When Dog Walker dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dog Walker from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dog Walker's disguise ability by paying {R/W}{R/W}, turning it face up.
Dog Walker triggers, creating two 1/1 Dog creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Dog, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

467-1978-2713-3263-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-1978-2713-3263-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

2781-3086-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Lagrella.
Lagrella leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile.
Lagrella and Felidar Guardian's enter-the-battlefield abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Felidar Guarrdian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lagrella.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1765-2733-4050.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Shimmering Wings enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings' second ability by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1171-1322-4499.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, exiling and returning Garth One-Eye onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-2292-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

586-1818-2034-2693.description:
Cast Priest of Gix.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Healer of the Pride triggers, gaining you 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix to add {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life to return Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
